reason: Those settlement emails already look like spam, and a site that cannot tell me if I even qualify, with listings I still have to check on the official page, is the same junk. I would Google one claim if I ever believed it and leave — I am not making an account.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? You don't. You just show me unverified listings and send me to file it myself.
would_change_my_mind: If I searched the one settlement I actually heard about, you showed a clear match against the official notice with no account, and the only link was the administrator I could verify myself.
